observations: Mumford double-fibre example is said to show that Pic zero need not be separated, with the qualification that it is then not representable. A second illustrated example concerns separable fibres and nonseparation of Pic.
The alpha/lambda/mu variation questions distinguish proposed inequalities from the inequality explicitly labelled connu. The correspondence-scheme existence question receives Oui, par Raynaud.
